definitions.explanation: An approximate quantity meaning roughly 20 to 90, used when the exact number is not important or not known. Combines with counters to indicate an approximate count.

examples.japanese: {数十人|すうじゅうにん}が{集|あつ}まった。
この{建物|たてもの}は{数十年|すうじゅうねん}{前|まえ}に{建|た}てられた。
examples.english: This building was built several decades ago.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{影響|えいきょう}で{数十万人|すうじゅうまんにん}が{避難|ひなん}{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: Hundreds of thousands of people are living as evacuees due to the earthquake.

notes:
An approximate number word in the {数|すう}～ series. {数|すう} prefixed to a number word indicates "several" of that unit. {数十|すうじゅう} means roughly 20–90, though the exact range is vague.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数十人|すうじゅうにん}: several dozen people
- {数十年|すうじゅうねん}: several decades
- {数十万|すうじゅうまん}: several hundred thousand
- {数十億|すうじゅうおく}: tens of billions

RELATED NUMBER WORDS:
- {数|すう}: several (prefix)
- {数百|すうひゃく}: several hundred
- {数千|すうせん}: several thousand
- {数万|すうまん}: tens of thousands

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何十|なんじゅう}: tens of — used in questions or exclamations, slightly different nuance
- {十数|じゅうすう}: ten-odd, between 10 and 19 — a smaller range than {数十|すうじゅう}
